Identity.Name: Pset_StingMEPServices
Identity.Definition: STING MEP service parameters with no buildingSMART property - circuit protective conductor size, pipe insulation thickness and drainage slope (DSCH-38).

Governance.StandardsBasis: BS 7671 (circuit protective conductors); BS 5422 (pipe insulation); BS EN 12056-2 (drainage gradients)

Property.name: ProtectiveConductorSize
Property.Definition: Circuit protective conductor size in mm2 per BS 7671. STING parameter ELC_CPC_SZ_MM. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_ElectricApplianceTypeCommon.ProtectiveConductorSize, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: InsulationThickness
Property.Definition: Pipe insulation thickness in millimetres. STING parameter PLM_PPE_INSULATION_THK_MM. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_PipeSegmentTypeInsulation.InsulationThickness, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).

Property.name: Slope
Property.Definition: Drainage pipe slope percentage per BS EN 12056 (1:80 default for sanitary). STING parameter PLM_SLOPE_PCT. DSCH-38: moved here from Pset_PipeSegmentTypeCommon.Slope, a property buildingSMART does not define (the Pset_ prefix is reserved for sets the IFC specification declares).
